# montecarlo_dremio_credentials (Data Source)

Dremio credentials are the access token Monte Carlo stores for Dremio connections to use. The token is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `db_name` (String) Dremio project or space to connect to. Null when none is set.
- `host` (String) Hostname of the Dremio Arrow Flight endpoint, such as `data.dremio.cloud` for Dremio Cloud (`data.eu.dremio.cloud` in the EU).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `port` (Number) Port Dremio serves Arrow Flight on.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `tls` (Boolean) Connect over TLS. Dremio Cloud requires it. Null when unset.
